Skill `llm-finetuning-training-engineer`.
Roles: `agent`, `eval_engineer`.
Tool `read_brief_and_run_files` (owner `agent`): via `read`; adds `brief_read`.
Tool `prepare_dataset_and_reports` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `brief_read`; adds `dataset_prepared`, `dataset_card_committed`, `validation_report_written`, `phase2_complete`.
Tool `produce_env_report` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `phase2_complete`; adds `env_report_present`; picks `env_status` with any of (`env_status` == 1, `env_status` == 2, `env_status` == 3).
Tool `generate_training_files` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `env_report_present` and `env_status` != 1; adds `train_files_generated`.
Tool `commit_training_files` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `train_files_generated`; adds `train_files_committed`.
Tool `launch_training_background` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `train_files_committed`; adds `training_running`.
Tool `poll_training_logs` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `training_running`; picks `run_state` with any of (`run_state` == 1, `run_state` == 2, `run_state` == 3, `run_state` == 4).
Tool `stop_training_run` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `training_running`; removes `training_running`.
Tool `rerun_preflight` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `run_state` == 2; picks `env_status` with any of (`env_status` == 1, `env_status` == 2, `env_status` == 3).
Tool `apply_oom_ladder_step` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `run_state` == 4; adds `oom_remediated`.
Tool `export_promoted_artifact` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `promotion_verdict_promote`; adds `artifact_exported`, `smoke_test_passed`.
Initially true: none.
Initially: `env_status` == 0.
Initially: `run_state` == 0.
Goal: any of ((`phase2_complete` and `env_report_present` and (`env_status` == 1 or `env_status` == 2) and `train_files_committed` and (`training_running` or `run_state` == 1 or `run_state` == 2 or `run_state` == 3 or `run_state` == 4)), (`phase2_complete` and `env_report_present` and `env_status` == 3), (`promotion_verdict_promote` and `artifact_exported` and `smoke_test_passed`)).
Protocol:
  - `agent` uses `read_brief_and_run_files`.
  - `agent` uses `prepare_dataset_and_reports`.
  - `agent` uses `produce_env_report`.
  - `agent` chooses one of (external):
    - branch `blocked`:
      - checkpoint: any of ((`phase2_complete` and `env_report_present` and (`env_status` == 1 or `env_status` == 2) and `train_files_committed` and (`training_running` or `run_state` == 1 or `run_state` == 2 or `run_state` == 3 or `run_state` == 4)), (`phase2_complete` and `env_report_present` and `env_status` == 3), (`promotion_verdict_promote` and `artifact_exported` and `smoke_test_passed`)).
    - branch `ready_or_ready_with_warnings`:
      - `agent` uses `generate_training_files`.
      - `agent` uses `commit_training_files`.
      - `agent` uses `launch_training_background`.
      - loop `monitor_run`:
        - `agent` uses `poll_training_logs`.
        - `agent` chooses one of (external):
          - branch `still_running`:
            - repeat `monitor_run`.
          - branch `completed`:
            - `agent` tells `eval_engineer` `checkpoint_ready`.
          - branch `environment_failure`:
            - `agent` uses `rerun_preflight`.
          - branch `divergence`:
            - `agent` uses `stop_training_run`.
          - branch `uma_oom`:
            - `agent` uses `stop_training_run`.
            - `agent` uses `apply_oom_ladder_step`.
      - `eval_engineer` chooses one of (observed):
        - branch `PROMOTE`:
          - `agent` uses `export_promoted_artifact`.
        - branch `REJECT`: none.
Behaviour of `eval_engineer`:
  - receive `checkpoint_ready` from `agent`.
